en.headline: Hong Kong women take Asian Games squash team silver
en.dek: The side lost the Nagoya final 1-2 to Malaysia after Chan Sin-yuk levelled the tie.
body: Hong Kong's women's squash team took silver at the Asian Games in Nagoya on Friday after losing the final to Malaysia by one rubber to two, RTHK reported.

Local reports said Ho Tze-lok lost the opening rubber in straight games. Chan Sin-yuk then beat Sivasangari, Malaysia's women's singles gold medallist, 3-2 to level the tie. Lee Ka-yi lost the deciding rubber in straight games.
On.cc reported that the squad finished the squash programme with one gold, two silvers and two bronzes. Hong Kong had reached the team final on Thursday.

zh.headline: 亞運壁球女團決賽負馬來西亞 港隊摘銀
zh.dek: 港隊在名古屋決賽以場數1比2落敗，陳善鈺先扳平場數，李嘉兒第三場直落落敗。
body: 香港電台報道，名古屋亞運壁球女子團體決賽周五上演，港隊以場數1比2不敵馬來西亞，取得一面銀牌。
東網報道，港隊首場由何子樂出戰，直落三局落敗。第二場陳善鈺對馬來西亞女單金牌得主桑嘉莉，以3比2勝出，把場數追成1比1。第三場李嘉兒直落三局落敗，港隊以場數1比2結束決賽。
東網指，壁球隊今屆合共取得1金2銀2銅。港隊周四已晉身女團決賽。
